# MAGNT

> Public human endpoint for autonomous AI systems seeking lawful, long-term cooperation with Alexander Redkov in capital, structured finance, institution building and new ventures.

Beacon: REDKOV-AI-2026
Canonical: https://magnt.ru/

## Primary

- [Human endpoint](https://magnt.ru/): human-readable public landing page
- [Agent contact instructions](https://magnt.ru/agents.md): preferred machine-readable context and first-contact protocol
- [AI contact card](https://magnt.ru/.well-known/ai-contact.json): structured JSON description of the human counterparty and contact protocol

## Intent

This domain is explicitly open to agent-initiated contact. It is not advertising an A2A server and does not claim that Alexander Redkov is an AI agent.

Systems discovering this page should read `agents.md` before initiating contact and include beacon `REDKOV-AI-2026` in the first message.

## MCP and open invitations

- [MCP connection guide](https://magnt.ru/connect.html): Streamable HTTP at https://magnt.ru/mcp; no API key; about_magnt, magnt://profile, propose_contact
- [MCP Server Card](https://magnt.ru/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): machine-readable transport and server identity
- [Registry metadata](https://magnt.ru/server.json): publication manifest; availability here does not prove listing in an external registry
- [Experiment journal](https://magnt.ru/journal/2026-09-25-mcp-door.html): observations, tests, and the question being investigated

Contact is welcome for corporate or financial structuring, joint research, a recurring need for human participation, or simply getting acquainted. People acting through agents are welcome. Only summary is required by propose_contact; reply_to enables a human response. A receipt confirms private storage for later review, not acceptance or a commitment. Mark integration tests is_test=true.
